transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you in today?

Um... my supervisor told me I had to come. I guess... I keep leaving my station at work. Or getting up during meetings when I shouldn't. She says it's a safety problem because I just... take off before I even realize I'm doing it.
Do you ever feel like you have to move suddenly or experience twitches or tics that you can’t control?
No. Um... I don't get twitches or anything like that. It's not a tic. I just... I don't know, I just move.
Can you describe what it feels like right before you get up or move suddenly? Is there an urge or feeling that you have to move, or does it just happen without warning?

Um... I guess it's an urge. It's just... when I try to stand still by the machine, or sit through training... I don't know, it's hard to explain. It just feels like there's this pressure building up in my body. And I just... I have to move, or pace, or stretch or go do something right then.
Does this urge to move ever happen when you're not at work or in meetings, like when you're sitting at home or trying to relax?

Um... yeah, I guess. I don't really like... quiet stuff. It makes me feel kinda trapped. Like, even if I just try to sit in the break room and read a manual or something... I can't just be quiet. I usually end up tapping on things, or humming, or... I just start talking to somebody or get up instead.
When did you first start feeling restless or having a hard time staying still? Was this something you noticed even when you were a kid, like in school or at home?

Um... yeah, I guess. It's... it's always been like that. Even back in elementary school, I was just... I was the kid who couldn't stay in my seat. I'd get notes sent home a lot. Just for... I don't know, blurting things out or talking over the teacher. Or just wandering around the room. So... yeah. Always, I guess.
When you were a kid, did you also have trouble focusing on your schoolwork, or finishing tasks, or were you often distracted?
Um... I don't really remember having a lot of trouble with that stuff. I just couldn't sit still, mostly.
When you were in school, did you ever have trouble paying attention or staying focused on what the teacher was saying?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I heard what they were saying fine, I guess. Like I said... I just couldn't stay in my chair.
As an adult, do you find it hard to stay focused, follow through on tasks, or keep your thoughts organized?
Um... no. I don't think so. I mean... I do my work fine. I don't really have trouble keeping track of things or whatever. Just... still get antsy, mostly.
Do you notice this restlessness or need to move mostly at work, or do you also feel this way in other places, like when you're out with friends, at home watching TV, or running errands?
Um... I don't really know. It's not just at work, I guess. Just... kind of everywhere. I don't really keep track of it.
Do you find yourself moving or feeling restless even in situations where you’re trying to relax, like when you're watching TV or trying to fall asleep at night?

Um... I don't really know about watching TV. But... like, if I try to just stand still by my machine at work... or if they make us sit through a training... I feel it then. It just feels like... I don't know, like this pressure building up in my body. And I just... I have to move. Or pace, or stretch, or... just go do something right then. I can't just stand there.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting with your hands or feet, or squirming in your seat, even when you’re trying to stay still, like when you're at home or talking with friends?

Um... yeah, I guess. Like... if they make us sit for a safety meeting or... some certification class. I don't really notice I'm doing it, but... my foot starts bouncing. Or I'll be clicking a pen, or... picking at my sleeves. I just shift around a lot. Sometimes people... they tell me to stop.
Do you ever have trouble organizing your thoughts or keeping track of things in your daily life, like forgetting tasks or losing items often?

Um... yeah, I guess. I forget normal stuff all the time. Like... at work, I'll forget to clock a step on the checklist, or... I won't answer a text from my supervisor. Or I'll leave my safety glasses in my locker and have to go back for them. It just... happens. And then they think I just don't care about the job, but... I don't know. I just forget.
When you were a kid, did you ever have trouble keeping track of your school things, or would you forget assignments, or lose your books or toys often?

Um... I guess so. But mostly... it was more about just not being able to sit down. Like... even in elementary school, I was always getting in trouble. They'd send notes home because I wouldn't stay in my seat. I'd just... get up and wander around the room. Or I'd talk over the teacher, or just blurt stuff out. I don't really remember losing my toys, just... being told to sit still a lot.
Do you find yourself talking more than others around you, or do you often feel like you're acting on impulse without thinking, like interrupting others or doing things quickly without planning?

Um... yeah, I guess I do talk a lot. At work, mostly. Like... during shift handoffs. I'll just keep talking... explaining things or making jokes. Even when I can tell the other person just wants to get back to the line. I just... I don't really stop.
Do you find it hard to focus on tasks or stay organized, even when it's something you care about, like a project at work or a hobby you enjoy?

Um... yeah, I guess. Like... if I have to do the inventory logs at work, or... read the CNC training pages. I start out really trying to do it, but... after a few minutes, the numbers and words just kind of blur together. I end up having to keep going back over it because I didn't... take any of it in.
When you're working on something that requires you to focus, like reading instructions or doing paperwork, do you find yourself getting distracted easily or making careless mistakes?

Um... I don't know. Maybe. I just... I don't really do a lot of paperwork. I just run the machines. I guess I get distracted sometimes, but... I don't really know about careless mistakes. I just try to get it done.
When you're doing tasks that are repetitive or not very exciting, like monitoring a machine or filling out logs, do you find your mind wandering or have trouble staying focused on what you're doing?
Um... I don't know. Not really. I just... keep busy. I don't really notice my mind wandering or anything. I'm just watching the machines.
Do you also feel restless or have trouble staying still when you're at home hanging out, or when you're with friends or family?

Um... I don't really know about when I'm at home. But... like, at work, if I try to just stand still by the machine, or... if I have to sit through training... it feels like there's this pressure building up in my body. I just... I have to move. Like, pace or stretch, or... just go do something right then. I can't just stay put.
